Subject: Vendor registration + PO/EDI questions for Vertex Health

Hi Irene,

Quick one — procurement kicked off vendor setup for Redwood Inference in our AP portal (link below). We need to confirm a few things before we finish:

- Do you have a preferred vendor code we should use in our system or should we create one and share?
- Our POs include a custom header field "project_code" that our receiving systems require for matching. Can your invoicing accept that field on both header and line levels?
- We prefer EDI submission but have an SFTP/manual CSV fallback window for new vendors. What is your expected turnaround for EDI reconciliation vs manual uploads?
- VAT: for our EU entities we typically apply reverse-charge on services. We need Redwood's VAT registration (or confirm self-billing acceptance) to process net invoices — please share guidance.

We have one sample PO to run a test (PO #75931). Can you confirm an ETA to submit a test invoice?

Portal link: https://vendor.vertexhealth.com/onboard/ABCD-1234

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lambert

Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO/EDI questions for Vertex Health

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and the portal link. We're ready to be onboarded. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Vendor code: Please create a vendor record on your side; share the vendor ID and we'll reference it on all invoices.
- Project_code: We can accept an additional "project_code" tag both at the invoice header and the line level. Our invoice parser maps header tags to PO header fields; we'll confirm mapping with Finance (cc'd).
- EDI vs fallback: We prefer EDI for production (faster reconciliation). For initial onboarding we can support CSV upload or SFTP with a 72-hour reconciliation SLA. If Vertex wants to push an immediate EDI connection, our integrations team can prioritize it but it typically takes ~2 weeks (TLS cert exchange + test cycles).
- VAT handling: Redwood can accept net invoices under reverse-charge if you supply the receiving entity and VAT registration we should be applying (and confirm your country of registration). Alternatively we can opt into a self-billing "VAT bridge" where Vertex issues the invoice and Redwood provides evidence for our records — we'll need the self-billing agreement signed.

I've attached our AP onboarding packet and the invoice template (CSV) for your mapping. For the test run, we can submit a single test invoice referencing PO 75931 by EOD Monday (Aug 2) if you confirm the vendor ID and whether you want the VAT net or gross flow.

Attachments: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet.xlsx; invoice_template.csv; bank_wiring_instructions.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick update from Finance/Integrations:

- project_code: we will map Vertex's project_code to our invoice header "project_reference" field. If they send as a line-level attribute, we'll surface it as line metadata but matching will occur on header project_reference + PO number. Recommend we ask them to populate header project_code for best results.
- EDI fallback: agree to 72-hour reconciliation for CSV; for EDI expedite, estimate 10 business days once certs are exchanged. We can do a one-off manual reconciliation for the initial test invoice if needed.
- VAT: we need Vertex to indicate which legal entity will receive the service and the in-country VAT number. Finance prefers Vertex issue net invoices under reverse-charge; the self-billing VAT bridge requires a signed MOU.

I'll be available for the EDI kick-off call if they want it.
